en: Black‑and‑white rural landscape showing a European village. In the center stands a prominent church on a low hill, with a walled churchyard and trees around it. The church has a tall tower topped with an onion‑shaped dome and spire. Below the hill, a dirt road curves through fields of grass toward several timber or stucco farmhouses and barns. Rolling hills and farmland form the background. There is no visible printed caption or handwritten text on the image side.
